summary: Frontend-only batch validation of theme bug fix, Quiz flow, rename propagation (Ownology Cellars / Rich / Hunter Valley / richard@ownology.ai), Founding-Member modal, Cellar Brief dry-run, and smoke pages. All 4 target features PASS. Theme regression PASS across all 6 themes.

ui_bugs.issue: Toast (bottom-center) overlays the Quiz result CTA 'See a Founding-Member plan →' and the Pricing 'Claim The Vigneron' area. In Playwright, force-clicks were intercepted by the toast — needed to dismiss it first to observe the /pricing navigation from quiz-cta-founding. Real user clicks still succeed via event bubbling, but the CTA is visually obstructed and click-target overlap is a UX risk.

action_items: OPTIONAL: Auto-hide the ThemeSuggestion toast on /quiz result step, or reposition so it doesn't overlap the primary CTA (currently blocks 'See a Founding-Member plan →').

OPTIONAL: The reservation modal 'Your Name' placeholder still reads 'Sarah Winemaker' — if the rename brief covers user-facing placeholders, consider updating to 'Rich Winemaker' or a generic archetype consistent with Onboarding/Admin.

OBSERVATION: Onboarding step 1 pre-fills 'Your First Name' input with value 'Sarah' (from state) — placeholder is 'Rich' as required, but the visible seeded value is stale. Not part of this brief; only surfacing.

MINOR: Theme id 'cellar' applies the 'dark' token but no matching 'theme-cellar' class on <html> — every other theme applies exactly one 'theme-*' token. No BAD_MIX, but the missing token is inconsistent with the pattern.
critical_code_review_comments: Theme invariants (regression fix) verified: for each of {parchment, soft-cellar, red-crush, white-crush, cellar, auto}, <html> never carries both 'dark' AND 'light-mode' simultaneously. applyThemeToDom is functioning as the single writer.
Quiz scoring behaves as expected — light red under $25 → Gamay (Beaujolais-Villages); citrus light under $25 → Clare Valley Riesling. quiz-cta-founding href='/pricing' and navigates correctly.
seed_data_creation: None. Used existing dev-bypass seed user (Ownology Cellars / richard@ownology.ai).
context_for_next_testing_agent: Base URL https://private-tutor-2.preview.emergentagent.com. Dev-bypass active. Note: theme-suggestion toast (bottom-center) can intercept Playwright clicks — always dismiss via [data-testid=theme-suggestion-close] before interacting with lower-page CTAs. Quiz value keys are: fruit, body, sweetness (bone_dry, hint, off_dry, sweet), grip, age, budget (under_25, 25_50, 50_100, 100_plus). Reservation modal has data-testid=reservation-modal-backdrop with inputs reservation-{name,email,winery,phone}-input. daily-alert-email dry-run returned fromEmail=alerts@ownology.ai and totals.errors=0.
